description: Create a new task item comment for a given task_item_id and created_by_id

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Serialization view for the created comment (default **normal**).

403.description: User does not have the required permissions

status.description:
The status of the task item at the time the comment is created.
Standard users who are assigned to the task item cannot change the status to closed or void.

task_item_id.description: The task_item associated with the comment

attachments.description:
Attachments.
To upload attachments you must upload the entire payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type and
specify each parameter as form-data together with `attachments[]` as files.
